vocabulary.description: Client session transport and GET /api/me: exactly one of an httpOnly cookie, or a bearer token returned by POST /api/login as {token} and sent as Authorization: Bearer <token>.
The helper exported from src/auth/index.js that other server routes use to get the current user (name and signature chosen by the team).
POST /api/events/:eventId/registrations: request, 201 {id,eventId,userId}, 409 on a repeat, 401 unauthenticated, 404 unknown event; what the UI relies on.
